**Headline defect of this run:** ten prompts emitted SQL containing
`WHERE -- unmapped tool_arg: …` — structurally invalid SQL presented as a
projection. This is the defect recorded as **F-078**.

Second headline: of the 22 SQL statements emitted across the set, only
**1 agreed with REST** when executed (see `docs/fixes/FIX_PLAN.md` §6).

## Defects surfaced by this run

| ID | Defect | Prompts |
|---|---|---|
| F-077 | AP invoice lines refused as "not in the API schema" | 13 |
| F-078 | Tool args with no `FilterSpec` emit invalid `-- unmapped` SQL | 1, 6, 12, 14, 16, 17, 18, 24, 30, 36 |
| F-082 | AR invoice *number* bound to `CUSTOMER_TRX_ID` | 22 |

All three are recorded in full in `docs/fixes/FIX_PLAN.md`.
